item.title: 7-Oh ban goes into effect soon
item.description: Been using Kratom for the better part of a decade, started using it to get off of Opiates after my 2nd spine surgery ... have had 4 more since then and earlier this year I started taking a 7oh concentrate instead of the Kratom extract I had been using. I don't expect compassion or a merit badge, but I am scared of the withdrawls and want to say it outloud without saying it to anyone I know. I have a job and a family, and this (sketchy, unregulated, probably slowly killing me) "supplement" helped me keep my job, keep up with my kid, and struggle through the daily excruciating pain. The only law I've ever broken is the speed limit, but before I started using Kratom I was desperate and for the only time considered trying "street drugs" (I recognize the line between this unregulated 7oh crap and buying pills stolen from granny is nearly invisible) and I am worried the pain or withdrawls will break me. Supposed to go on a huge camping trip this weekend with my family and the families of several coworkers... it's never the IDEAL week to stop sniffing glue, but the ban is days away and I have to stop some time.
